increment_paragraph: **MEMBER-ACCESS-PROJECTION** (round 18; USER REQUEST 2026-11-05, verbatim: "We're still needed to handle tons of unsupported instructions on our corpus...", then "Member access first"): the census of the user's `quirin-audit current` run at Fluent Bit 046accf6 binds every one of its 9,996 `indirect memory access is outside the resource projection` leaves (2,346 functions, 162 units, 267 sole-blocker functions) to the Clang AST of the unit's own analysed text (186 of 186 preprocessed texts reproduced with matching SHA-256) and gives each one refusal premise: pointer member read 2,395, uncontracted callee 1,888, sub-object address 1,778, union 749, pointer stored into a member 1,814, no evaluated access 227, custody-free read or store 342, the rest forms and roots outside every typed reader. Probes on the base show readings (a), (b) and (d) already hold where a route types the root at a custody-free position; the sole-blocker mass is member custody through a formal parent (25 functions release a formal's member or element and keep the parent, 50 store an identity-carrying pointer into a member), which no summary mode states, so the card stops there on a user choice (MEMBER-CUSTODY-THROUGH-FORMAL-PARENT: a member-effect summary recommended). The one reading defect fixed is gateway rule 38h: a declaration with no `=` that the lexical gate refused (a typedef specifier, so `rd_segment_t *seg, *tmp;` read its second `*` as a dereference; a constant-expression bound) takes the keyword branch's admission and unchanged `NoOp` only when its unique Clang node is one `DeclStmt` of automatic, uninitialized, constant-typed `VarDecl`s; every other answer keeps the refusal and nothing the gate admitted is consulted (141 leaves on the 046accf6 run). Lean `QCore.TypedDeclarationReading` (132 decision vectors bound to the Rust table, the keeping theorems, the `NoOp` lowering); fixtures `crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/member_access_projection.rs`. Predicted: corpus Unknown -> Safe for crc32c_zeros_op, ut_testConflictingPreviousAssignments and crc32c_zeros; system and slice no move. Report: docs/reports/member-access-projection/README.md.

ledger.title: A body that releases or stores into a member of a formal parent it keeps has no summary mode: a user choice
ledger.text: Registered by MEMBER-ACCESS-PROJECTION (046accf6 current run, census in docs/reports/member-access-projection/census/). Of the 267 functions the indirect-access refusal alone blocks, 25 release a member or element of a formal parent and keep the parent (cmt_opts_exit, metric_release_storage, free_chunk_header, rd_kafka_metadata_partition_clear, the twelve *_destroy_array helpers), 50 store a pointer that may carry an identity into a member (map->unit = cfl_sds_create(unit), confval->name = name) and 5 hand an embedded list's address to a releasing helper (rd_list_destroy(&conf->...)); across the run 2,395 pointer-member-read and 1,814 pointer-store leaves. Rule 5k admits a member release only when the body also releases the parent (P4); otherwise the effect is on the caller's object and no summary mode states it. Options: (1, recommended) a member-effect summary: per formal, the members a body releases and the members it stores a custody-carrying value into, checked against the body like rule 5k's P1-P3 and rule 13a, applied at the call site to the caller's place map (a released member's later use refused or accused as 5k's caller guard does; a stored member a field link in CG11's owned-field model), with contract-spec grammar, loader, gateway and Lean parity; (2) class 8 read strictly: a borrowed parent's member is an interior borrow, its release and stores into it refused by name, no verdict moves; (3) keep rule 5k as it stands and re-attribute the rest to a named refusal like rule 12k, no verdict moves. Recommended: 1, with 3's re-attribution first. The card that takes it should first run docs/reports/member-access-projection/scripts/run_current_census.py (the indirect-census build's call-argument and parity streams), which names each refused actual's position and route answer; it should also size statements with two calls (strlen(a->p) + strlen(b->q) is refused while each call alone is admitted). DISCHARGE: a user decision and the card it names, measured.
